title: tests/kernel/test_rng.c: in-kernel tests for crypto2dev DRBG
description: Kernel module testing the wolfkm DRBG registration. Tests: (1) generate 10,000 bytes without error; (2) generated bytes are not all-zero and not all-0xFF (trivial bias check); (3) two successive 32-byte generations produce different output; (4) SP 800-90A DRBG known-answer test: seed with known entropy, generate, compare against expected output from tests/vectors/drbg.h; (5) reseed call succeeds. Print pass/fail per check.
design: Use crypto_alloc_rng('stdrng'). crypto_rng_generate() and crypto_rng_reset() (for reseed). The KAT vector in tests/vectors/drbg.h must use the wolfCrypt DRBG algorithm (Hash-DRBG or CTR-DRBG, whichever wolfCrypt implements) with a known seed — find this in wolfssl/wolfcrypt/test/test.c. See DESIGN.md §rng.
acceptance_criteria: 10K generation succeeds. No trivial bias. KAT vector matches. Two successive 32-byte outputs differ. Module unloads cleanly.
